name: Rodeo Finance OracleTWAP samples an AMM spot price on a predictable schedule
summary: OracleTWAP priced unshETH as the plain mean of four spot samples of a thin Camelot pair, one taken per keeper update every 30 minutes. The attacker sandwiched three updates to inflate the samples, then opened leveraged unshETH positions whose oracle-based slippage and health checks let borrowed USDC buy the attacker's unshETH at the inflated price.
notes: The age runs from StrategyHelper's oracle assignment of OracleTWAP to unshETH (a price-source change, rule 10), 42 minutes after OracleTWAP's deployment; the later InvestorActor migration is not counted because the previous actor reached the same oracle.

Loss is the USDC the Rodeo USDC Pool lent into the four positions (rule 14). The unshETH those positions bought (about 431) stayed in StrategyLong as position collateral and is not subtracted; the attacker's net realised take was about 470 ETH ($885k).
The three pump-and-dump pairs around keeper updates only execute Camelot code and are preparation, not campaign transactions.
